LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.5 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Vocabulary development • Reading strate
Topic 2.7: Guided Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading, part of Reading 2.5 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Vocabulary development • Reading strate in Grade 5 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: What techniques can you use to better understand a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify and interpret vocabulary related to parts of the body as used in the context (e.g. 听、看、闻、走路 、跑步、说 etc.),

2. read a text and record the new words and phrases encountered,

3. use the new words to create sentences and read them out for peer feedback,

4. read texts about functions of the body and answer simple questions,

5. take turns asking each other comprehension questions about the given text,

6. create a word wall to display vocabulary words they encounter in texts by providing definitions and example sentences collaboratively,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify and interpret vocabulary related to parts of the body as used in the context (e.g. 听、看、闻、走路 、跑步、说 etc.),
2. read a text and record the new words and phrases encountered,
3. use the new words to create sentences and read them out for peer feedback,
4. read texts about functions of the body and answer simple questions,
5. take turns asking each other comprehension questions about the given text,
6. create a word wall to display vocabulary words they encounter in texts by providing definitions and example sentences collaboratively,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and Imagination: Networking skills are promoted when the learner collaboratively creates a word wall to help with

understanding the vocabulary they encounter while reading texts.

Values:
Unity: The learner takes turns in activities and conversations when they ask each other comprehension questions on the text.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-awareness: The learner becomes aware of the different body parts and their functions through reading the texts on the

theme.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner relates their learning to Science and Technology on the concept of body parts and their functions.
